quiz.title: Vocabulaire de base : objets scolaires, objets du quotidien
quiz.subject: Anglais

answers.correction: The English word for 'stylo' is 'pen', which is a common writing instrument used for writing or drawing.
The English word for 'cahier' is indeed 'notebook', which is a common item used for writing notes, drawing, or organizing information.
'Goodbye', 'See you later', and 'Take care' are all common English expressions used to say goodbye or indicate that you will see someone again in the future.
The English word for 'gomme' is indeed 'eraser', which is a common item used to remove pencil marks from paper.
The English word for 'sac à dos' is 'backpack', which is a common item used to carry books, supplies, and personal belongings.
The English word for 'bureau' is indeed 'desk', which is a common piece of furniture used for writing, working, or studying.
The English word for 'règle' is 'ruler', which is a common item used to measure length or draw straight lines.
The English word for 'chaise' is indeed 'chair', which is a common piece of furniture used for sitting.
